name: 宗谷
description: まのさば新規加入 ジャンルCP雑多 読み方はそうやです 稍微懂中文　I can read English.

works.body:
Hello! I saw your artwork on the home page and gave you a look. Your art style has a real 'delicate' feel to it that I think would be a good choice for a commission idea I've had.

Are you familiar at all with doekuramori[1] and their Citadel series? I think the main character, The Martyr, is extremely cute. In her official art her clothes are revealing with a cyberpunk feeling, but in flashbacks we occasionally see her in more modest clothing.

I would love to see a picture in your style where Martyr-chan is wearing a cute hoodie, skirt and thigh-highs with a winter feeling. Her outfit has her wearing like a headset, maybe that could be a pair of headphones? I'll include some references to give you an impression of the overall feeling I'm interested in.

Thank you for your consideration!

[1]: https://x.com/citadeldev
